subject: Year 3 trip to Chester Zoo
text:
Dear Parents and Carers,

Oakfield Primary School

As part of our science topic on habitats, Year 3 will be visiting Chester Zoo on Thursday 16th October. The coach will leave school promptly at 8.15am, so please make sure your child arrives by 8am. We expect to return at approximately 4.30pm.

The cost of the trip is £18.50, which covers the coach and entry. Please pay via ParentPay by Friday 10th October and return the attached consent form by the same date.

Children will need a packed lunch, a named water bottle and a waterproof coat.

Kind regards,
Mrs A. Example
Year 3 Teacher
